title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:

Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E05 — The Hopefuls
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

title: Bonanza
description:

The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:

Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E09 — Breed of Violence
A sheriff's daughter runs off with her boyfriend (John Ericson), unaware he is a murderous bank robber.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E10 — The Last Viking
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.

title: Bonanza
description:

An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.

title: Bonanza
description:

Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E13 — Silent Thunder
Little Joe runs into romantic complications when he tries to teach a deaf girl sign language; guest Albert Salmi.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E14 — The Ape
Adam and Little Joe warn Hoss when he tries to help Arnie, a man with the mind of a child and an uncontrollable temper.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E15 — The Blood Line
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E16 — The Courtship
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E17 — The Spitfire
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E19 — The Gunmen
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E20 — The Fear Merchants
A potential mayoral candidate attempts to stir up trouble between majority and minority groups in town.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E21 — Spanish Grant
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E23 — Desert Justice
A Ponderosa ranch hand faces charges of killing the wife of the U.S. marshal who came to arrest him.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E08 — Opie's Ill-Gotten Gain
Opie gets straight A's on his report card, much to Andy's delight. But when Opie finds out that his teacher made an error, he cannot figure out how to tell the truth without disappointing his father.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E10 — Up in Barney's Room
Barney moves into the courthouse jail after his landlady evicts him. When he learns that she is planning to sell her home and marry someone she just met, Barney suspects that she is the victim of a con man.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E09 — A Date for Gomer
Thelma Lou refuses to go with Barney to the town's upcoming dance unless he gets her visiting cousin Mary Grace a date. Just when he and Barney are about to give up, Gomer appears.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E11 — Citizen's Arrest
Gomer makes a citizen's arrest of Barney for an illegal U-turn, the same violation Barney has ticketed him for, causing him to overreact and resign as deputy.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E12 — Opie and His Merry Men
Opie and his friends take their roles as Robin Hood's men seriously when they befriend a hobo.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E13 — Barney and the Cave Rescue
Barney organizes a rescue party when Andy and Helen become trapped in a cave after it collapses. Unbeknownst to Barney, the two have already escaped, but decide to go back into the cave to save him from becoming a laughingstock.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E14 — Andy and Opie's Pal
Opie becomes jealous when he thinks Andy likes Trey, his new best friend, more than him. Andy then decides to teach Opie a lesson in friendship.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E15 — Aunt Bee the Crusader
Aunt Bee organizes a protest to keep Mr Frisby, the local egg farmer, from getting evicted because of a highway project. However, unbeknownst to her, Mr Frisby is hiding a big secret.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E16 — Barney's Sidecar
Barney adds a vintage motorcycle to the rolling stock of the Mayberry Sheriff's Department.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E17 — My Fair Ernest T. Bass
A mountain-bred would-be Romeo is brought into Andy's home to be taught some manners.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E18 — Prisoner of Love
Andy and Barney fall for the charms of a female prisoner who threatens to crumble the security of the Mayberry jail.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E19 — Hot Rod Otis
Otis Campbell acquires a car and threatens the lives and limbs of Mayberry's pedestrian population.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E05 — Canadian Transplants Seek RV
Susan and Todd Cranford want to show off the U.S. to their children.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E06 — Full Time Travel Trailer
Travel nurse Jaci and her best friend Amanda look for a travel trailer that Jaci can live in full-time.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E07 — Cross-Country RV Adventure
Breana Evans and Robert Haley move into their RV full-time so they can live a more intrepid lifestyle.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E08 — RV For Trips With Grandkids
Phil and Mary get ready to take their family on the road with a Class C unit, easier to drive than other models, but still comfortable.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E09 — Upgrade For Family Of Five
Brian and Diane love vacationing with their family in their RV, and they look to invest in a larger, more comfortable unit.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E10 — Newlyweds Look For A New RV
Newlyweds Noëlle and Andrew are ready to take their work as health coaches on the road.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E11 — Young Couple Seeks A Class C
Adventure lovers Katie and Noah are shopping for a RV to take them around the United States.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E12 — Travel Trailer For Athletic Triathlons
Denise and Brian have loved camping their entire lives and plan to go full-time when Brian retires, so they are searching for an RV that will help them see places not accessible by airplane.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E13 — Trailer To Travel The US
Veterans Jennifer and Kory are ready to hit the road and explore every corner of the United States with their family in an RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E14 — Fifth Wheel To Call Home
Kym and Kevin want to make the move out of Los Angeles and look for a large fifth wheel to call home.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E01 — First Time Full-Timers
An Atlanta family decides to try out RV living with hopes of simplifying their busy lives and spending more time with their kids.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E02 — Fifth-Wheel For Financial Firm
A young couple trades in their home for an RV while simultaneously growing a successful business.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E03 — Kid-Friendly Bunkhouse
A Georgia couple that wants to continue family traditions with their children looks to upgrade to an RV that meets everyone's needs.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E04 — Motorhome For Motorcycles
A couple with four children looks for a motorhome that can keep up with their on-the-go lifestyle.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E05 — Interim Rv Living
A family of five from Washington searches for a fifth-wheel to call home while they build their dream home; the couple hopes to find an RV with an open floor plan and separate master bedroom.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E06 — RV for Retirement
A couple goes on the lookout for a motor home to take on new adventures and enjoy the perks of retirement; an RV with a bath and a half, plenty of sleeping space and comfortable to drive.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E07 — Bunks For Brothers
A family of four, always on the go in their travel trailer, decide to upgrade to a newer, drivable RV with a bunkhouse for the kids, a roomy kitchen, easy maneuverability and plenty of sleeping space.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E08 — ATV Toy Hauler
A Nevada couple decides to buy an RV that will allow them to set up camp while going on ATV trips with friends; a toy hauler with dry camping capabilities, an open floor plan and an ATV garage.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E09 — Easing Into Camping
A Texas couple wants to spend more quality time with their daughters while easing them into outdoor adventures in an RV; a lightweight, easy-to-tow travel trailer.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E10 — New Priorities, New RV
After a recent health scare, a couple decides to make new priorities that include having fun and making memories while taking family trips in an RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E11 — Luxury On Wheels
A fun-loving couple tries to compromise on an RV upgrade that will cater to his rugged camping style and her glamorous camping style.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E12 — Fifth-Wheel For Fifty States
A couple hopes to find the perfect RV that will help them achieve their goal of visiting all 50 states.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E13 — RV For Horse Shows
Caitlin and Sam swap out hotel rooms for a well-equipped RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E14 — Bear-Proof RV
Rod and Camille want to provide their young sons with more outdoor adventures, so they are looking for their very first RV to take on camping trips.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E01 — Full-Time RV For Vegas Couple
After a scary four-wheeler accident, a Las Vegas couple reevaluates what they really want in their RV home life; they search for a rig with more room for their granddaughter, plenty of exterior storage space and a bigger kitchen and shower.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E02 — His Toy Hauler or Her Bunkhouse
Kari and her husband, Jose, search for their first travel trailer, hoping to give their young daughter happy camping memories; however, the couple must decide between his toy hauler and her bunkhouse.
